name: Cpr First Aid
overview: Cpr Emergency Care is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include immediate action can prevent complications; call emergency services for severe presentations. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.

steps.title: Check responsiveness and breathing
steps.description: Tap shoulders and look for normal breathing within 10 seconds.

steps.title: Call for help
steps.description: Activate emergency services and request an AED if available.

steps.title: Start chest compressions
steps.description: Push hard and fast in center of chest, 100–120/min, depth ~5 cm.

steps.title: Provide rescue breaths if trained
steps.description: 30 compressions followed by 2 breaths when trained and willing.

dos: Switch rescuers every 2 minutes if possible
donts: Do not stop until help arrives or person responds
Do not perform on normal breathing victims

faq.question: Can I rely on this cpr information instead of a doctor visit?
faq.answer: No. This content supports learning and preparation for conversations with qualified healthcare professionals. It is not a substitute for diagnosis or treatment.
